comparison.objective: Candidate tunes an industrial damper; record composes a target mass from hooked weights and places it on a scale.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires hex-key engagement, fine collar rotation, counterholding, locking torque, and iterative cycling; record requires weight selection, hook handling, and placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate has explicit energy, velocity, stroke, repetition, damage, and retention criteria. Board record omits setup, scoring, target tolerance, and run limits.
comparison.reason: Mass composition and weighing test quantitative selection and placement, not damping calibration or lock retention.
